subject: English
question_text: Read the beginning of a story. Add at least ten new sentences to complete the story.
stimulus: It was a holiday. Rimi was staying home alone as her parents had gone to their village home. They told Rimi to remain careful and also assured that they would come back before evening. She thought of making a good use of her lonely time. She was fond of reading adventure stories and so started reading one. Suddenly she heard a sound...... 15
